topic: EBK 回歸預測 (地統計分析工具)
section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The input point features containing the field that will be interpolated.
The field of the input features containing the values of the dependent variable. This is the field that will be interpolated.

Input rasters representing the explanatory variables that will be used to build the regression model. These rasters should represent variables that are known to influence the values of the dependent variable. For example, when interpolating temperature data, an elevation raster should be used as an explanatory variable because temperature is influenced by elevation. You can use up to 62 explanatory rasters.
The output geostatistical layer displaying the result of the interpolation.

The output raster displaying the result of the interpolation. The default cell size will be the maximum of the cell sizes of the explanatory variable rasters. To use a different cell size, use the cell size environmental setting.

Output polygon feature class that shows the regions of each local model and contains fields with diagnostic information for the local models. For each subset, a polygon will be created that surrounds the points in the subset so you can easily identify which points were used in each subset. For example, if there are 10 local models, there will be ten polygons in this output. The feature class will contain the following fields: Number of Principal Components (PrincComps)—The number of principal components that were used as explanatory variables. The value will always be less than or equal to the number of explanatory variable rasters. Percent of Variance (PercVar)—The percent of variance captured by the principal components. This value will be greater than or equal to the value specified in the Minimum cumulative percent of variance parameter below. Root Mean Square Error (RMSE)—The square root of the average squared cross-validation errors. The smaller this value, the better the model fits. Percent 90 Interval (Perc90)—The percent of data points that fall within a 90 percent cross-validation confidence interval. Ideally, this number should be close to 90. A value significantly smaller than 90 indicates that standard errors are being underestimated. A value significantly larger than 90 indicates that standard errors are being overestimated. Percent 95 Interval (Perc95)—The percent of data points that fall within a 95 percent cross-validation confidence interval. Ideally, this number should be close to 95. A value significantly smaller than 95 indicates that standard errors are being underestimated. A value significantly larger than 95 indicates that standard errors are being overestimated. Mean Absolute Error (MeanAbsErr)—The average of the absolute values of the cross-validation errors. This value should be as small as possible. It is similar to Root Mean Square Error, but it is less influenced by extreme values. Mean Error (MeanError)—The average of the cross-validation errors. This value should be close to zero. A value significantly different than zero indicates that the predictions are biased. Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS)—The continuous ranked probability score is a diagnostic that measures the deviation from the predictive cumulative distribution function to each observed data value. This value should be as small as possible. This diagnostic has advantages over cross-validation diagnostics because it compares the data to a full distribution rather than to single-point predictions.

parameters.label_zh: 因變量測量誤差欄位 （可選）
parameters.description_en: A field that specifies the measurement error for each point in the dependent variable features. For each point, the value of this field should correspond to one standard deviation of the measured value of the point. Use this field if the measurement error values are not the same at each point. A common source of nonconstant measurement error is when the data is measured with different devices. One device might be more precise than another, which means that it will have a smaller measurement error. For example, one thermometer rounds to the nearest degree and another thermometer rounds to the nearest tenth of a degree. The variability of measurements is often provided by the manufacturer of the measuring device, or it may be known from empirical practice. Leave this parameter empty if there are no measurement error values or the measurement error values are unknown.

parameters.label_zh: 方差的最小累積百分比 （可選）
parameters.description_en: Defines the minimum cumulative percent of variance from the principal components of the explanatory variable rasters. Before building the regression model, the principal components of the explanatory variables are calculated, and these principal components are used as explanatory variables in the regression. Each principal component captures a certain percent of the variance of the explanatory variables, and this parameter controls the minimum percent of variance that must be captured by the principal components of each local model. For example, if a value of 75 is provided, the software will use the minimum number of principal components that are necessary to capture at least 75 percent of the variance of the explanatory variables. Principal components are all mutually uncorrelated with each other, so using principal components solves the problem of multicollinearity (explanatory variables that are correlated with each other). Most of the information contained in all explanatory variables can frequently be captured in just a few principal components. By discarding the least useful principal components, the model calculation becomes more stable and efficient without significant loss of accuracy. To calculate principal components, there must be variability in the explanatory variables, so if any of your explanatory variable rasters contain constant values within a subset, these constant rasters will not be used to compute principal components for that subset. If all explanatory variable rasters in a subset contain constant values, the output diagnostic feature class will report that zero principal components were used and that they captured zero percent of the variability.

Polygon features defining where the local models will be calculated. The points inside each polygon will be used for the local models. This parameter is useful when you know that the values of the dependent variable changes according to known regions. For example, these polygons may represent administrative health districts where health policy changes in different districts. You can also use the Generate Subset Polygons tool to create subset polygons. The polygons created by this tool will be non-overlapping and compact.

Type of transformation to be applied to the input data. None—Do not apply any transformation. This is the default. Empirical—Multiplicative Skewing transformation with Empirical base function. Log empirical—Multiplicative Skewing transformation with Log Empirical base function. All data values must be positive. If this option is chosen, all predictions will be positive.

parameters.label_zh: 半變異函數模型類型 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The semivariogram model that will be used for the interpolation. Exponential—Exponential semivariogram Nugget—Nugget semivariogram Whittle—Whittle semivariogram K-Bessel—K-Bessel semivariogram

parameters.label_zh: 各局部模型中的最大點數 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Maximum number of points in each local model (Optional)
parameters.description_en: The input data will automatically be divided into subsets that do not have more than this number of points. If subset polygon features are supplied, the value of this parameter will be ignored.

parameters.label_zh: 局部模型區域重疊系數 （可選）
parameters.description_en: A factor representing the degree of overlap between local models (also called subsets). Each input point can fall into several subsets, and the overlap factor specifies the average number of subsets that each point will fall into. A high value of the overlap factor makes the output surface smoother, but it also increases processing time. Values must be between 1 and 5. If subset polygon features are supplied, the value of this parameter will be ignored.
The number of simulated semivariograms of each local model. Using more simulations will make the model calculations more stable, but the model will take longer to calculate.

Defines which surrounding points will be used to control the output. Standard is the default. Standard Circular Max neighbors—The maximum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Min neighbors—The minimum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Sector Type—The geometry of the neighborhood. One sector—Single ellipse. Four sectors—Ellipse divided into four sectors. Four sectors shifted—Ellipse divided into four sectors and shifted 45 degrees. Eight sectors—Ellipse divided into eight sectors. Angle—The angle of rotation for the axis (circle) or semimajor axis (ellipse) of the moving window. Radius—The length of the radius of the search circle. Smooth Circular Smoothing factor—The Smooth Interpolation option creates an outer ellipse and an inner ellipse at a distance equal to the Major Semiaxis multiplied by the Smoothing factor. The points that fall outside the smallest ellipse but inside the largest ellipse are weighted using a sigmoidal function with a value between zero and one. Radius—The length of the radius of the search circle.

topic: Huff Model (Business Analyst Tools)
text: Creates a probability surface to predict the sales potential of an area based on distance and an attractiveness factor.

topic: Huff Model (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
The Input Facility Features parameter layer is a point layer that represents competitors or existing stores.
The Input Candidate Features parameter layer is a point layer that represents the potential stores layer to evaluate.
The Huff Model tool takes into account all of the locations in the Input Facility Features parameter layer but only a single feature in the Input Candidate Features parameter layer in an analysis. You can limit the locations in an analysis by selecting either the Input Facility Features or Input Candidate Features parameter layer.
The attractiveness value used for the analysis must be the same field in the Input Facility Features and Input Candidate Features parameters.
The Input Sales Potential Features parameter layer can be a point layer or a polygon layer that has a numeric field representing sales potential. It can be based on disposable income or population, for example, or any other variable.

topic: Huff Model (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
The Enrich Layer tool can be used to derive the Input Sales Potential Features parameter layer.
Geodesic distance is used for distance calculations.

topic: Assign Customers By Distance (Business Analyst Tools)
text: Assigns customers to the closest store based on a selected distance type.

topic: Assign Customers By Distance (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
The ID of the closest store is assigned to each customer. Store assignments are influenced by the selected value for Distance Type.
An Origin-Destination matrix calculates the least-cost paths between customers and stores using the Business Analyst network dataset and routing service.
When using a network distance type, you can adjust the Search Tolerance parameter value to define the maximum distance the input customer features can be from a road. Customer points beyond this distance will not receive a store assignment.
If a store cannot be assigned to a customer point, the new Store ID value will be null and the Distance value will contain a -1.

topic: 創建 NetCDF 圖徵圖層 (多維工具)
text:
此工具支持具有 .nc 和 .nc4 擴展名的 netCDF 文件。 不支持 .nc4 文件中位于組內的組變量和維度。 僅支持組外的變量和維度。
對于非常大的 netCDF 文件，工具完成與 netCDF 圖層的初始繪制之間可能會存在延遲。 后續圖層繪制將不會存在延遲。
netCDF 圖徵圖層可用作任何可接受圖徵類作為輸入的地理處理工具的輸入。
可使用保存至圖層文件工具將臨時圖徵圖層保存為圖層文件或使用復制圖徵工具將此圖層保存為新圖徵類。
如果指定相同的圖層名稱，則將覆蓋現有圖徵圖層。
輔助座標變量將在 X 變量和 Y 變量下拉列表中列出并在執行期間使用（如果指定）。 其未在維度值參數下拉列表中列出，也無法在命令行或腳本中將其設置為此參數的值。
圖層中的圖徵數量與行維度中唯一值的數量相同。 如果選擇多個維度，則記錄數量是這些維度中唯一值數量的乘積。
如果未指定行維度，則將僅創建一個圖徵。
欄位類型由 NetCDF 變量類型確定。
非行維度的第一個值用于創建多維變量的默認視圖。
在 ArcGIS 中無法使用已分配給 netCDF 文件的時間座標變量的日歷屬性值 noleap 和 365_day。

The dimension or dimensions set here determine the number of features in the feature layer and the fields that will be presented in the feature layer's attribute table. For instance, if StationID is a dimension in the netCDF file and has 10 values, by setting StationID as the dimension to use, 10 features will be created (10 rows will be created in the feature layer's attribute table). If StationID and time are used, and there are 3 time slices, 30 features will be created (30 rows will be created in the feature layer's attribute table). If you will be animating the netCDF feature layer, it is recommended, for efficiency reasons, to not set time as a row dimension. Time will still be available as a dimension that you can set to animate through, but the attribute table will not store this information.
A netCDF variable used to specify elevation values (z-values) for features.
A netCDF variable used to specify linear measurement values (m-values) for features.

The value (such as 01/30/05) of the dimension (such as time) or dimensions to use when displaying the variable in the output layer. By default, the first value of the dimension or dimensions will be used. Value table columns: Dimension—A netCDF dimension. Value—The value of the dimension to use.

Specifies the dimension value selection method that will be used. By value—The input value will be matched with the actual dimension value. By index—The input value will be matched with the position or index of a dimension value. The index is 0 based; that is, the position starts at 0.

section: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text:
需具備 3D Analyst 許可方可使用。
需具備 Spatial Analyst 許可方可使用。
山體陰影工具通過為網格中的每個像元確定照明度值，來獲取表面的假定照明度。 該工具通過設置假定光源的位置并計算每個像元相對于相鄰像元的照明度值來實現此目的。 它可以顯著增強用于分析或圖形顯示的表面的可視化效果，尤其是在使用透明度時。
默認情況下，陰影和光是與從 0 到 255（從黑色到白色遞增）的整數關聯的灰色陰影。

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text: 為任何特定位置創建山體陰影地圖時，主要因素是太陽在天空中的位置。

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text: 方向角指的是太陽的角度方向，是以北為基準方向在 0 到 360 度范圍內按順時針進行測量的。 90 度的方位角指向為東。 默認方位角為 315 度 (NW)。

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text: 高度指的是照明源高出地平線的角度或坡度。 高度的單位為度，范圍為 0（位于地平線上）到 90（位于頭上）之間。 默認值為 45 度。

通過將高程網格放置在山體陰影網格的上方，然后對高程網格的透明度進行調整，可創建外觀精美的地表地貌圖。 要了解如何調整顯示和外觀，請參閱影像外觀。

通過對陰影建模（默認選項），您可以計算局部照明以及像元是否在陰影中。
通過對陰影進行建模，可識別一天的特定時間內將要落入其他像元陰影的各個像元。 位于其他像元陰影中的像元編碼為 0；所有其他像元的編碼為介于 1 和 255 之間的整數。 可將所有大于 1 的值重分類為 1，從而生成二元輸出網格。 在以下示例中，黑色區域位于陰影中。 這兩張圖像中的方位角相同，只是太陽角度（高度角）已修改。

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text:
以高于地平線的角度指定照明源的高度角。 但是，用于計算山體陰影值的公式要求該角度以弧度表示，并且是相對于垂直線的偏轉。 將從表面垂直向上的方向（正上方）標注為天頂。 天頂角為天頂點與光源方向的夾角，是高度角的 90 度余角。 要計算照明角度，首先要將高度角轉換為天頂角。 接下來，將角度轉換為弧度。
將高度角轉換為天頂角：
\(Zenith_{deg} = 90.0 - Altitude \quad \quad (2)\)
轉換為弧度：
\(Zenith_{rad} = Zenith_{deg} * \pi / 180.0 \quad \quad (3)\)

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text:
以度為單位指定照明源的方向和方位角。 山體陰影公式要求方位角采用弧度作為單位。 首先，將方位角從地理單位（羅盤方向）轉換為數學單位（直角）。 接下來，將方位角轉換為弧度。
轉換方位角的方法：
\(Azimuth_{math} = 360.0 - Azimuth + 90.0 \quad \quad (4)\)
請注意，如果 \(Azimuth_{math}\) >= 360.0，則將出現以下情況：
\(Azimuth_{math} = Azimuth_{math} - 360.0 \quad \quad (5)\)
轉換為弧度：
\(Azimuth_{rad} = Azimuth_{math} * \pi / 180.0 \quad \quad (6)\)

topic: 山體陰影工具的工作原理
text:
移動 3 x 3 窗口將移動至輸入網格中的每個像元，對于位于窗口中心的每個像元，其坡向和坡度值將通過一種將納入 8 個相鄰像元值的算法進行計算。 這些像元使用字母 a 至 i 進行標識，其中 e 表示當前正在計算坡向的像元。
像元 e 在 x 方向上的變化率將通過以下算法進行計算：
\([dz/dx] = ((c + 2f + i) - (a + 2d + g)) / (8 * cellsize) \quad \quad (7)\)
像元 e 在 y 方向上的變化率使用以下算法進行計算：
\([dz/dy] = ((g + 2h + i) - (a + 2b + c)) / (8 * cellsize) \quad \quad (8)\)
表面上每個像元的最陡坡降是坡度。 結合 z 因子的以弧度為單位的坡度計算算法如下：
\(Slope_{rad} = \arctan (z_factor * √ ([dz/dx]^2 + [dz/dy]^2)) \quad \quad (9)\)
最陡坡坡降面向的方向為坡向。 以弧度為單位的坡向的范圍從 0 到 2 \(\pi\)，其中 0 表示朝向東。 坡向是根據以下算法中的規則確定的：

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
text:
此網格工具集包含了用于執行網格資料管理和網格處理的工具。 這些工具允許您使用網格資料集屬性并創建和處理網格資料。
下表列出了網格工具集中的工具集：

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 創建和編輯鑲嵌資料集。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從遙感影像創建正射校正影像鑲嵌。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 復制、創建和鑲嵌網格資料集。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 執行準備網格資料以供使用的任務。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 創建、查看和編輯網格資料集屬性。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
text: “鑲嵌資料集”工具集包含管理、分析和顯示網格集合的工具。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 添加網格至鑲嵌資料集
用于將文件、文件夾、表或 web 服務等各種來源的網格資料集添加到鑲嵌資料集。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 定義在企業級地理資料庫中編輯鑲嵌資料集時，非所有者能夠執行的編輯操作。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 檢查鑲嵌資料集是否存在錯誤以及可能的改進。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 在添加新網格資料集到范圍超出先前覆蓋范圍的鑲嵌資料集時更新邊界的范圍。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 計算鑲嵌資料集中每個網格的范圍。 從鑲嵌資料集添加或移除網格資料集并想要重新計算輪廓線時使用此工具。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 構建鑲嵌資料集項目緩存
插入“緩存網格”函數，作為鑲嵌資料集中所有函數鏈的最后一步。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 定義并生成鑲嵌資料集的概視圖。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 為鑲嵌資料集生成或更新接縫線。 接縫線用于排序重疊影像并生成更平滑的鑲嵌。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 根據空間分辨率計算鑲嵌資料集中網格資料集的可見性等級。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 清除與鑲嵌資料集相關的像素緩存。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 對鑲嵌資料集進行色彩平衡處理，從而使切片無縫顯示。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 識別在指定時間點后發生更改的鑲嵌資料集中的區域。 在對鑲嵌資料集進行更新或同步，或需要更新衍生產品（例如緩存）時經常使用該工具。 該工具可將此類進程限制為僅適用于已更改的區域。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 在鑲嵌資料集中找到最能代表鑲嵌區域的影像候選項。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 在地理資料庫中創建一個空的鑲嵌資料集。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從現有鑲嵌資料集中創建單獨的鑲嵌資料集。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 指定要表示為 NoData 的一個或多個值。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 允許您設置生成鑲嵌資料集概視圖的方式。 構建概視圖工具將使用您通過此工具創建的設置。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從磁盤刪除鑲嵌資料集、其概視圖和其項目緩存。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 在鑲嵌資料集或包含網格函數的網格圖層中添加、替換或移除函數鏈。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 創建顯示鑲嵌資料集的輪廓線、邊界、接縫線或空間分辨率的圖徵類。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 將鑲嵌資料集中處理過的影像副本以網格文件格式保存到指定的文件夾。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 為鑲嵌資料集中的各個項目創建文件路徑表。 可指定該表是包含所有文件路徑，還是只包含損壞的路徑。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 根據像素的顏色或通過裁剪值范圍對其進行掩膜。 此工具的輸出被用作平衡鑲嵌資料集色彩工具的輸入，用于消除云和水體等能夠影響所用統計信息的區域，以便對多個影像進行色彩平衡處理。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 用于對鑲嵌資料集中包含的影像集合執行批量分析或處理。 可以單獨或以組的形式處理輸入鑲嵌資料集中的影像。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 修改鑲嵌資料集中輪廓線、邊界或接縫線的幾何，使其與圖徵類相匹配。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 將鑲嵌資料集中的多個項目分組為一個項目。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 鑲嵌資料集轉移動鑲嵌資料集
將鑲嵌資料集轉換為兼容 ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps 的移動鑲嵌資料集。 移動鑲嵌資料集位于移動地理資料庫中。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從鑲嵌資料集中移除網格
從鑲嵌資料集中移除所選的網格。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 如果曾移動或復制鑲嵌資料集，請重置源影像的路徑。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 定義用于顯示鑲嵌資料集并將其用作影像服務的默認設置。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 對使用合并鑲嵌資料集項目合并在一起的鑲嵌資料集項目進行分割。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 同步鑲嵌資料集以使其保持最新狀態。 除同步資料外，還可更新概視圖（如果基礎影像發生更改）、生成新的概視圖和緩存以及恢復鑲嵌資料集項目的原始配置。 您也可使用此工具移除源資料的路徑。 要修復路徑，請使用修復鑲嵌資料集路徑工具。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
text:
正射映射工具集包含可以用來從遙感影像創建正射校正影像鑲嵌的工具；遙感影像包括由有理多項式系數 (RPC) 模型描繪的衛星影像和航空影像以及 UAV 和 UAS 影像。
相關詳細信息，請參閱 ArcGIS Pro 中的正射映射。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 分析控制點覆蓋范圍并標識需要額外控制點來改善局域網平差結果的區域。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 將控制點和現有控制點表合并在一起。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 將地理校正應用到鑲嵌資料集項目。 該工具使用計算區域網平差工具中的解決方案表。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 根據用戶提供的立體像對構建鑲嵌資料集的立體模型。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 計算對鑲嵌資料集的校正。 該工具將創建一個解決方案表，用于應用實際的校正。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 通過原始影像的 EXIF 標頭估計并優化外部和內部相機模型。 之后，該模型將應用于鑲嵌資料集且可以選擇使用工具生成的高分辨率數字表面模型 (DSM) 實現更好的正射校正。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 在鑲嵌資料集與參考影像之間創建控制點。 然后，可將控制點與連接點一起用于計算鑲嵌資料集的校正。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 使用控制點和解決方案點為組成鑲嵌資料集的每個圖像計算深度圖。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 計算鑲嵌資料集中每個圖像的圖像空間和膠片空間中的基準座標。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 計算重疊鑲嵌資料集項目之間的連接點。 連接點隨后可用于計算鑲嵌資料集的區域網平差。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從包含幀影像的鑲嵌資料集中導出幀和相機參數。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 可在對鑲嵌資料集執行正射映射區域網平差后生成報告。 當評估正射映射產品的質量和精度時，該報告將非常重要。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 基于立體像對生成 3D 點并以一組 LAS 文件的形式輸出點云。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 從點云對數字地形模型 (DTM) 或數字表面模型 (DSM) 進行插值。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 針對其中一個重疊影像中的給定地面控制點和初始連接點創建匹配的連接點。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 通過運行計算深度地圖工具來移除創建的深度地圖。

topic: 網格工具集概述
english: An overview of the Raster toolset
values: 可從基準表構造仿射變換，以優化鑲嵌資料集中每個圖像的內部方向。

english: An overview of the Raster toolset

english: An overview of the Raster toolset
section: 網格資料集工具集概覽

values: 下載影像服務或鑲嵌資料集中的源文件。

從輸入網格函數或函數鏈生成網格資料集。

english: An overview of the Raster toolset

values: 將多個現有網格資料集或鑲嵌資料集合并到一個現有網格資料集中。

topic: Color Coded Layer (Business Analyst Tools)
text: Creates multilevel, scale-dependent choropleth layers from a variable describing a business, demographic, consumer, or landscape characteristic.

topic: Color Coded Layer (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
The output is a group layer containing scale-dependent administrative geography levels with a user-defined variable. By default, all levels and all features within each level are included in the group layer.
Local data or online data can be used to create a color-coded layer. The data can be explored through the data browser.
The Area of Interest parameter defines the geographic extent of the analysis. The following also pertain to the area of interest: It is only supported with local data. The output creates a feature dataset. If specified, administrative geography levels intersecting the area of interest that include more than 10,000 features will not be included in the group layer. If specified, it enables the Color Coded Group Layer symbology pane and ribbon contextual menu and supports additional settings and usability features outside of this tool.
When the Classification Method parameter is set to Auto, the following methods will be used for each variable type: Method Variable Type Natural Breaks (Jenks) Count, Density Equal Interval Median, Rate, Per capita Standard Deviation Average, Percent, Index, Ratio

topic: Color Coded Layer (Business Analyst Tools)
text:
Custom data (.sdcx file) variables only include the custom feature layer; multiple levels will not be created.
Use the Secondary Variable parameter to map two variables with a single grid color ramp to classify both attributes.
When two variables are selected, the default symbology option will be Bivariate Colors.

values: Specifies the method that will be used to calculate the class breaks. Natural Breaks (Jenks)—Natural breaks classes are based on natural groupings inherent in the data. Class breaks that best group similar values and maximize the differences between classes will be identified. This is the default. Quantile—Each class will contain an equal number of features. A quantile classification is well suited to linearly distributed data. Equal Interval—The range of attribute values will be divided into equal-sized subranges. This allows you to specify the number of intervals and will automatically determine the class breaks based on the value range. Standard Deviation—Class breaks will be placed above and below the mean value at a specified interval size, such as 2, 1, or 0.5, in the unit of standard deviation, until reaching the minimum and maximum values of the input variable. Geometric Interval—Class breaks will be created based on class intervals that have a geometric series. The geometric coefficient in this classifier can change once (to its inverse) to optimize the class ranges. Auto—Classification methods will be automatically defined using the variable metadata. This presents the recommended thematic map style based on the data type.

text: 用于構建定位器的參考資料每一行都需要 ObjectID，并且該資料不包含一個 ObjectID。 資料庫中未注冊的資料庫視圖或表視圖不符合此要求，并且使用一個 ObjectID 構建定位器會導致無法使用重新構建地址定位器工具重新構建定位器。

topic: 002964：不支持將不含 ObjectID 的資料源作為 '' 角色的參考資料。
english: 002964: A data source without an ObjectID is not supported as reference data for the '<value>' role.
text:
執行以下操作之一：
使用注冊到地理資料庫工具將表或視圖注冊到地理資料庫。 然后使用注冊的視圖創建定位器。
如果資料源為地理資料庫視圖，請將該視圖添加到地圖，然后在創建定位器或創建圖徵定位器工具中將其選中。 此方法可行，因為將不含 ObjectID 的視圖添加到地圖時，將創建臨時 ESRI_OID 欄位。
如果資料源是來自資料庫連接的空間或非空間表視圖，請將不支持重復項的整型欄位添加到資料源以用作主鍵或表示 ObjectID。 然后，在構建定位器時，使用資料源作為輸入參考資料。
如果資料源是事件圖層，則將該圖層轉換為地理資料庫圖徵類。

topic: 010101：先驗概率文件中的類 <value> 不在特征文件中。
english: 010101: Class <value> in the a-priori probability file is not in the signature file.
text:
相對于其他一些類，先驗概率賦給某些類更高的權重。 此先驗信息來自于您對正在進行分類的地表的了解。 特征文件包含分類中要使用的所有類的統計資料。 給定輸入后，定義先驗信息的先驗概率文件指定在特征文件中不可用的類。
例如，如果在執行阿拉斯加州一個邊遠地區的分類，可能要賦予針葉樹更高的概率。 在分類過程中，如果某一像元可能是多個類中的一個，則在分類過程中要賦給針葉樹類更高的權重，從而使像元更可能被分類為包含針葉樹。

topic: 裁剪網格 (資料管理工具)
text:
使用此工具可以基于模板范圍提取部分網格資料集。 該裁剪輸出包含與模板范圍相交的所有像素。 要提取圖徵資料集的一部分，可以使用分析工具箱 中的裁剪工具。
通過使用以 x 和 y 座標的最小值和最大值確定的包絡矩形或使用輸出范圍文件來指定剪切區域。 如果指定的裁剪范圍未與輸入網格資料集對齊，則該工具可驗證是否已使用適當的對齊方式。 這可能會導致輸出的范圍與工具中指定的范圍略有不同。
可以將已有的網格或向量圖層作為剪切范圍使用。 如果使用圖徵類作為輸出范圍，則可以通過圖徵類的最小外接矩形或圖徵的面幾何來裁剪網格。 使用裁剪幾何時，可能提高輸出的像素深度。 確保輸出格式可以支持適當的像素深度。
您還可以使用顯示范圍內的選定圖徵作為裁剪范圍。 如果選定圖徵類中的某一圖徵并選中使用輸入圖徵裁剪幾何參數，則輸出將裁減掉選定區域。 如果選定圖徵類中的某一圖徵，但未選中使用輸入圖徵裁剪幾何參數，則輸出將把該圖徵的最小外接矩形裁剪掉。
可以通過交互方式在地圖網格上繪制面并將其用作裁剪范圍。 單擊在當前地圖內創建新圖徵以用作輸入下拉列表，然后單擊面。 然后將指針移至地圖以數字化面。 雙擊即可完成裁剪面。 注: 可用于裁剪網格圖層的唯一選項為面。
可將輸出結果保存為 BIL、BIP、BMP、BSQ、DAT、Esri Grid、GIF、IMG、JPEG、JPEG 2000、PNG、TIFF、MRF 或 CRF 格式，或任意地理資料庫網格資料集。
該工具支持多維網格資料。 要對多維網格中的每個切片運行工具并生成多維網格輸出，請務必將輸出保存為 CRF。 支持的多輸入維網格資料集類型包括多維網格圖層、鑲嵌資料集、圖像服務和 CRF。

在點、線或面圖徵類中標識位于最中心的圖徵。
了解有關“中心圖徵”工作原理的詳細信息

topic: 中心圖徵 (空間統計工具)
text:
與資料集中所有其他圖徵的距離累積最小的圖徵是位于最中心的圖徵；選擇此圖徵并復制到一個新創建的輸出圖徵類。 多個圖徵可以共享與所有其他圖徵的最小累積距離。 如果出現此情況，上述所有處于最中央位置的圖徵都將被復制到輸出圖徵類。
累積距離使用距離方法參數指定的歐氏距離或曼哈頓距離進行測量。
對于線和面圖徵，距離計算中會使用圖徵的質心。 對于多點、折線或由多部分組成的面，將會使用所有圖徵部分的加權平均中心來計算質心。 點圖徵的加權項是 1；線圖徵的加權項是長度；而面圖徵的加權項是面積。
此工具支持點圖徵的 3D 特性，在提供 z 值的情況下，將在其計算中使用 x、y 和 z 值。 因為這些結果本質上是 3D 圖徵，因此需要在場景中進行可視化。 要正確可視化分析結果，請確保在場景中運行分析或將結果圖層復制到場景中。
地圖圖層可用于定義輸入圖徵類。 使用帶選區的圖層時，只有選定的圖徵才會包含在分析中。
案例分組欄位用于為獨立的中心圖徵計算進行圖徵分組。 案例分組欄位可以是整型、日期型或字符串類型。 對于案例分組欄位，具有空值的記錄將從分析中排除。
自身潛能是圖徵與其自身之間的距離或權重。 通常情況下，此權重為零，但在某些情況下，您可能要為每個圖徵指定其他固定值或某一個不同的值（例如，可能基于面大小）。 注意： 在使用 shapefile 時，請注意 shapefile 無法存儲空值。 根據非 shapefile 輸入創建 shapefile 的工具或其他過程可能會將空值存儲（或解釋）為零。 某些情況下，空值則以極大的負值儲存于 shapefile 中。 這會產生意外的結果。 有關詳細信息，請參閱 shapefile 輸出的地理處理注意事項。

topic: 對齊圖徵 (編輯工具)
text: 用于標識地理處理工具用于標識搜索距離中輸入圖徵與目標圖徵的不一致部分并使其與目標圖徵對齊。

topic: 對齊圖徵 (編輯工具)
text: 此工具會修改輸入資料。 有關詳細信息以及避免意外更改資料的策略，請參閱修改或更新輸入資料的工具。

topic: 對齊圖徵 (編輯工具)
text:
所有輸入必須處于同一座標系。
輸入圖徵和目標圖徵可以是線或面圖徵。 例如，您可能有作為線或面的郡縣邊界，但其中的一部分不同于河流中心線，河流中心線是郡縣邊界和相鄰郡縣的邊界。 此工具可用于將部分郡縣邊界與河流中心線對齊，以保持其重疊。
當輸入圖徵或其一部分與目標圖徵的距離位于指定搜索距離值范圍內時，該輸入圖徵或其一部分將成為對齊候選項。 候選項形狀必須與目標形狀類似。 例如，平行的輸入道路圖徵和目標道路圖徵相比以 90 度角相互交叉的兩個圖徵更為相似。
如果經過指定，則匹配欄位參數將用于確定對齊候選項是否可能是其目標的正確匹配圖徵。 例如，如果在目標圖徵的搜索距離內發現兩個輸入圖徵，且這兩個圖徵在形狀上都與目標相似，則具有匹配欄位值的圖徵將是更合適的候選項。
對齊將保留輸入圖徵間的現有拓撲關系。 例如，如果一條端點與其它線相連的線因對齊而移動，則所有連接線的端點都會移動，以保持線的連接。
隨即將 AF_CONF 欄位添加至已修改輸入。 該欄位存儲著一個 0-100 間的值，表示每個圖徵對齊的置信度。 值為 100 表示對齊的候選項沒有不明確現象。 指定匹配欄位參數后，值會隨著發現多個潛在候選項、形狀差別更大或屬性不匹配而降低。 值 -1 賦予未修改的圖徵。 由于輸入和目標圖徵可能存在的復雜性，可能會發生非預期對齊。 因此，有必要進行后續檢查，尤其是具有相對較低 AF_CONF 值的圖徵。

in_features_orig = "common_border"
in_features_copy = "common_border1"

# Features to which input will be aligned

search_dist = "100 Meters"
match_fields = [["A_field", "B_field"]]

text:
# Name: ManageMapServerCacheStatus.py
# Description: The following stand-alone script demonstrates how to delete
# Status of cache using ManageMapServerCachStatus tool

# Any line that begins with a pound sign is a comment and will not be run
# Empty quotes take the default value.
# To accept arguments from the command line replace values of variables to
# "sys.argv[]"

# Import system modules
import arcpy
import sys
import time
import datetime

# Set environment settings
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/data"

# List of input variables for map service properties
connectionFile = r"C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Roaming\ESRI\Desktop10.1\ArcCatalog"
server = "arcgis on MyServer_6080 (publisher)"
serviceName = "Rainfall.MapService"
inputService = f"{connectionFile}\\{server}\\{serviceName}"
scales = ""
manageMode = "DELETE_CACHE_STATUS"
numOfCachingServiceInstances = "2"
outputFolder = ""
areaOfInterest = ""
reportExtents = ""

currentTime = datetime.datetime.now()
arg1 = currentTime.strftime("%H-%M")
arg2 = currentTime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
file = f'C:/data/report_{arg1}.txt'

# Print results of the script to a report
report = open(file, 'w')

# Use "scales[0]", "scales[-1]", "scales[0:3]"

try:
    starttime = time.clock()
    result = arcpy.server.ManageMapServerCacheStatus(
        inputService,
        manageMode,
        scales,
        numOfCachingServiceInstances,
        outputFolder,
        areaOfInterest,
        reportExtents
    )
    finishtime = time.clock()
    elapsedtime = finishtime - starttime

    #print messages to a file
    while result.status < 4:
        time.sleep(0.2)
    resultValue = result.getMessages()
    report.write(f"completed {resultValue}")

    print(f"Reported the Bundle status for scale = {scales[-1]} of {serviceName} at {outputFolder}")
    print(f"using specified feature class {areaOfInterest} in {elapsedtime} sec {arg2}")

except Exception as err:
    # If an error occurred, print line number and error message
    tb = sys.exc_info()[2]
    report.write(f"Failed at step 3 \nLine {tb.tb_lineno}")
    report.write(str(err))

report.close()

parameters.description_en: The map image layer for which the cache status will be modified. You can choose it by browsing to the desired service in Portal or you can drag and drop a web tile layer from the Catalog pane Portal tab to supply this parameter.

Specifies the action that will be performed on the cache status information used by the server. Delete cache status—Deletes the status information used by the server. Rebuild cache status—Deletes, then rebuilds the status information used by the server. Rebuild bundle status—Creates status information in a new file geodatabase named Status.gdb in a folder you specify in the Output Folder parameter. This option is used when you want to create a custom status report for a particular area of interest or set of scales.
The scale levels for which the status will be modified. This parameter is only applicable when building a custom status using the Rebuild bundle status option for the Manage Mode parameter.
Defines the number of instances that will be used to update/generate the tiles. The value for this parameter is set to unlimited (-1) and cannot be modified.
Output folder for the Status.gdb. This parameter is only applicable when building a custom status using the Rebuild bundle status option.
An area of interest (polygon) that determines what geography the status report will cover. This parameter is only applicable when building a custom status using the Rebuild bundle status option.

A rectangular extent defining the area for which the status will be built. This parameter is only applicable when building a custom status using the Rebuild bundle status option. Note that the Area Of Interest parameter allows you to specify an area of interest that is nonrectangular. Current Display Extent —The extent will be based on the active map or scene. Draw Extent —The extent will be based on a rectangle drawn on the map or scene. Extent of a Layer —The extent will be based on an active map layer. Choose an available layer or use the Extent of data in all layers option. Each map layer has the following options: All Features —The extent of all features. Selected Features —The extent of the selected features. Visible Features —The extent of visible features. Browse —The extent will be based on a dataset. Clipboard —The extent can be copied to and from the clipboard. Copy Extent —Copies the extent and coordinate system to the clipboard. Paste Extent —Pastes the extent and coordinate system from the clipboard. If the clipboard does not include a coordinate system, the extent will use the map's coordinate system. Reset Extent —The extent will be reset to the default value. When coordinates are manually provided, the coordinates must be numeric values and in the active map's coordinate system. The map may use different display units than the provided coordinates. Use a negative value sign for south and west coordinates.

text:
雖然此錯誤可能會發生，但發生的頻率非常低，以至于我們尚且無法確定典型原因，也因此目前沒有可用的解決方案。
如果您能夠使用反饋表單來提供有關導致此錯誤的所用步驟的詳細信息，那么此舉將有助于我們在未來確定和提供解決方案。
幫助信息包括下列內容：
消息 ID 以及錯誤或警告消息
工具的名稱
用于參數的值
相關資料集詳細信息
如果該工具不再處于打開狀態，則您可以在地理處理歷史記錄中找到這些詳細信息。
我們對您所提供的一切信息深表感激。 感謝您為我們改進錯誤代碼文檔所做出的貢獻。

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
text: 支持“自動提交”環境的工具將在企業級地理資料庫事務中進行指定次數的更改后強制執行提交。

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
text:
該設置的工作方式與企業級地理資料庫初始化參數 AUTOCOMMIT 相同。
此環境可幫助防止事務變得過大而超過資料庫管理系統 (DBMS) 日志。 有關管理事務的信息，請參閱 DBMS 文檔。
較高的提交值可以改善性能，但在達到存儲容量時或在提交前發生錯誤會造成編輯內容丟失，因此還必須對這種可能性進行權衡。

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
text: 自動提交 - 事務將自動提交的間隔。 如果設置為 0，事務僅在發出顯式提交命令時才進行提交。

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
text: arcpy.env.autoCommit = interval_value

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
values: 0—當發出顯式提交命令時事務才進行提交。 interval—事務將在每個間隔變化時自動提交。 ""—默認每 1000 次更新進行一次自動提交。

topic: 自動提交 (環境設置)
text:
import arcpy

# Set the autoCommit environment to 2000.
arcpy.env.autoCommit = 2000

text: 該工具在線性參考系統中創建了 LRS 網絡。 輸入特征類必須是空的, 并位于包含 LRS 資料集的特性資料集中。 輸入特征類必須不是空的, 并且居住在含有 LRS 資料集的特性資料集中。 輸入特征類不一定已經登記在現有的 LRS 網絡中。 如果輸入工作空間包含一個以上的 LRS 網絡中, 則選擇的 LRS 用于網絡注冊。 輸入特征類名稱必須是 26 個或更少字符。 輸入特征類的 x、 耐受性和 x, y 分辨率必須與 LRS 的容忍度和分辨率設置相匹配。 在 ArcGIS 線性引用引用 LRS 輸出參數中, 更多了解 LRS 的寬容度和分辨率設置。 輸出 LRS 網絡的測量單位是使用x, y- 容忍度之間的轉換系數確定的。和輸入特性類的分辨率和分辨率。例如,輸入特征類以米為空間參照單位,x,Y,容忍度為0.001米,x,分辨率為0.0001米。如果m,容忍和分辨率值與x,容忍度和分辨率相同,則測量單位為米。但是,如果m,容忍度為0.00001,m,分辨率為0.000001,測量單位為公里。這是因為0.001米等于0.00001公里。

original.text:
The tool creates an LRS Network in a linear referencing system (LRS).
The input feature class must be empty and reside in a feature dataset that contains an LRS dataset. The input feature class must not already be registered with an existing LRS Network.
If the input workspace contains more than one LRS, the selected LRS will be used for network registration.
The input feature class name must be 26 or fewer characters.
The x,y-tolerance and x,y-resolution of the input feature class must match the tolerance and resolution settings of the LRS. Learn more about tolerance and resolution settings for the LRS in ArcGIS Linear Referencing
The unit of measure for the output LRS Network is determined using the conversion factor between the x,y-tolerance and resolution and the m-tolerance and resolution of the input feature class. For example, an input feature class has a spatial reference in meters, with an x,y-tolerance of 0.001 meters and an x,y-resolution of 0.0001 meters. If the m-tolerance and resolution values are the same as the x,y-tolerance and resolution, the unit of measure will be meters. However, if the m-tolerance is 0.000001 and the m-resolution is 0.0000001, the unit of measure will be kilometers. This is because 0.001 meters equals 0.000001 kilometers.

original.text:
By default, the tool will output an LRS Network that does not support lines. To create an LRS Network that supports lines, check the Include Fields to Support Lines parameter and map the additional fields required for an LRS line network (line ID, line name, and line order). To create an LRS derived network, check the Derive From Line Network parameter and provide the LRS line network to which the LRS derived network will be registered.
This tool does not alter the input feature class and will instead add information to internal metadata tables to register the input feature class as the LRS Network feature class.
A feature class can only be registered as one LRS Network feature class at a time. Delete the LRS Network to which a feature class is registered to use a feature class that is already registered.
An input field can only be mapped to one LRS Network field parameter at a time.
The output of this tool is an LRS Network that will reside in the same workspace as the input feature class.

parameters.description_en: The input feature class that will be registered as the LRS Network. The name of the feature class must be 26 or fewer characters. The feature class must reside in a geodatabase that contains an LRS. The name of this feature class will be used as the name of the LRS Network.
The LRS name to which the new LRS Network will be registered. The LRS must reside in the same geodatabase as the LRS Network Feature Class value.
The field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network route ID. This must be a string or GUID field type.

parameters.label_zh: 路線名稱欄位( 可選)
parameters.description_en: A string field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network route name. This parameter is required only when the Route ID Field Configuration parameter is set to Autogenerated Route ID.
A date field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network from date.
A date field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network to date.

Specifies whether the network will be configured as an LRS derived network. Checked—The output of this tool will be an LRS derived network. The Line Network Name parameter value must also be provided. Unchecked—The output of this tool will not be an LRS derived network. This is the default.

The name of the LRS line network to which the output LRS derived network will be registered. The input LRS line network must reside in the same geodatabase workspace as the LRS Network Feature Class value. This parameter is only used if the Derive From Line Network parameter is checked.

parameters.label_zh: 包含支持行的欄位( 可選)
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the network will be configured to support lines. Checked—The output of this tool will be an LRS line network. The Line ID Field, Line Name Field, and Line Order Field parameter values must also be provided. Unchecked—The output of this tool will not be an LRS line network. This is the default.

parameters.label_zh: 行 ID 欄位( 可選)
parameters.description_en: The field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network line ID. This parameter is only used if the Include Fields to Support Lines parameter is checked. This must be a string or GUID field type and must match the field type and length of the route ID field in the centerline sequence table. It must also be the same field type as the Route ID Field parameter value.
A string field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network line name. This parameter is only used if the Include Fields to Support Lines parameter is checked.

parameters.label_zh: 線條順序欄位( 可選)
parameters.description_en: An integer field in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be mapped as the LRS Network line order. This parameter is only used if the Include Fields to Support Lines parameter is checked. This must be a long integer field type.

parameters.label_zh: 路由 ID 外地配置(可選)
parameters.description_en: Specifies the route ID field configuration that will be used for the LRS Network. Autogenerated Route ID—The route ID field will be an automatically generated GUID. The route name can be configured as an LRS field. This is the default. Single-Field Route ID—The route ID field will be a single user-generated field. Only nonline networks are supported. Multi-Field Route ID—The route ID field will be a user-generated field concatenated from more than one field to form the route ID. Only nonline networks are supported.

The individual fields in the LRS Network Feature Class value that will be used to form the route ID. This parameter is only used if the Route ID Field Configuration parameter value is Multi-Field Route ID. The fields must be either string or integer field types.

steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Create LRS Network From Existing Dataset，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。LRS 網絡功能類 [in_feature_class]、LRS 名稱 [lrs_name]、線路ID外地 [route_id_field]、路線名稱欄位( 可選) [route_name_field]、發自日期欄位 [from_date_field]、至日期欄位 [to_date_field]、從線網( 可選) [derive_from_line_network]、網絡名稱( 可選) [line_network_name]、包含支持行的欄位( 可選) [include_fields_to_support_lines]、行 ID 欄位( 可選) [line_id_field]、行名欄位( 可選) [line_name_field]、線條順序欄位( 可選) [line_order_field]、路由 ID 外地配置(可選) [route_id_configuration]、欄位(可選) [individual_route_id_fields]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

在以下示例中，計算值工具將使用按屬性選擇圖層、復制圖徵和緩衝區工具。 這些工具將選擇 LABEL 欄位包含 HIGHWAY 一詞的所有道路，制作其副本，然后對道路進行緩衝處理。

text:

def fn(InputFC):
 # To allow overwriting outputs change overwriteOutput option to True.w
 arcpy.env.overwriteOutput = True
 # Process: Select Layer By Attribute (Select Layer By Attribute) (management)
 InputFC_Layer, Count = arcpy.management.SelectLayerByAttribute(InputFC, "NEW_SELECTION", "LABEL LIKE '%HIGHWAY%'")
 # Process: Copy Features (Copy Features) (management)
 copyFeaturesOutput = "C:\\temp\\Output.gdb\\copyFeaturesOutput"
 arcpy.management.CopyFeatures(InputFC_Layer, copyFeaturesOutput)
 # Process: Buffer (Buffer) (analysis)
 bufferOutput = "C:\\temp\\Output.gdb\\bufferOutput"
 arcpy.analysis.Buffer(copyFeaturesOutput, bufferOutput, "1500 Feet")
 return bufferOutput

topic: 翻譯事件措施(遠程參考工具)
text: 將點或線性事件層的度量(m值)從一個線性參考方法(LRM)轉換為另一個線性事件層。該工具的一個使用實例是將事件資料從一英里基網絡轉化為一個公里基網絡。除了措施外,事件特征的路線聯系也可能在兩個LRM之間有所不同。該工具的輸出是一個特性類,具有目標的LRS網絡的正確度量和路徑關聯。
translation: 英文原頁機譯，請核對原文

original.text:
Translates the measures (m-values) of a point or line event layer from one linear referencing method (LRM) to another.
A use case for this tool would be to translate event data from a mile-based network to a kilometer-based network.
In addition to measures, the route associations of the event features may also be different between the two LRMs. The output of this tool is a feature class with the correct measures and route associations of the target LRS Network.

topic: 翻譯事件措施(遠程參考工具)
text: 輸入事件層必須是一個點或線性特征類。 此工具不會修改任何輸入, 并將創建特性類作為輸出。 此工具支持一次時間代表。 在運行此工具之前, 創建一個基于時間的定義查詢, 或者對輸入事件層和目標 LRS 網絡應用基于時間的選擇 。 如果為輸入層配置了時間, 也可以使用 ArcGIS Pro 中的時間滑動器 。 該工具支持將事件與存在缺口的路徑相對應。 如果目標網絡是 LRS 線條網絡, 也稱為工程網絡, 則可以翻譯輸入事件層, 即使輸入事件層的原始網絡不支持行的概念 。 輸出特性類類型- 行或點-必須與輸入事件圖層類型匹配。 輸入事件圖層的容度和分辨率設置應該與目標 LRS 網絡的容度和分辨率設置相匹配。
translation: 英文原頁機譯，請核對原文

original.text:
The input event layer must be a point or line feature class.
This tool does not modify either input and will create a feature class as an output.
This tool supports one temporal representation at a time. Create a time-based definition query or apply a time-based selection set to the input event layer as well as the target LRS Network before running this tool. The time slider in ArcGIS Pro can also be used if time is configured for both of the input layers.
This tool supports translating events against routes with gaps.
If the target network is an LRS line network, also known as an engineering network, the input event layer can be translated even if the original network of the input event layer does not support the concept of lines.
The output feature class type—line or point—must match the input event layer type.
The tolerance and resolution settings for the input event layer should match those of the target LRS Network.

topic: 翻譯事件措施(遠程參考工具)
text: 要識別翻譯過程中出現的匹配條件, 在輸出特征類中創建了一個名為 Loc_ Error 的欄位, 包含多匹配、 部分匹配、 無匹配和無錯誤等值。 輸入事件層的屬性欄位包含在輸出特性類中 。 如果目標 LRS 網絡包含并行路線, 請使用同步路線匹配選項 。 如果連接路徑標識的路徑與同步路線匹配, 輸入事件層必須注冊為 LRS 事件層。 此工具將在目標 LRS 網絡上對輸入事件層進行空間覆蓋, 以生成目標網絡沿線輸入事件的功能 。 這些功能將包含路徑標識并測量該位置在路徑上的位置的信息 。 輸入事件層和輸入程序目標網絡應只代表一個時間點以獲得準確輸出。如果輸入事件層代表多個時間點,則使用時間滑動器設置過濾器或使用日期列上的定義查詢。
translation: 英文原頁機譯，請核對原文

original.text:
To identify matching conditions that occur during the translation, a field called Loc_Error is created in the output feature class containing values such as Multi-Match, Partial Match, No Match, and No Error.
The attribute fields of the input event layer are included in the output feature class.
If the target LRS Network contains concurrent routes, use the Concurrent Route Matching option.
If Route with matching Route ID is used with Concurrent Route Matching, the input event layer must be registered as an LRS event layer.
This tool will perform a spatial overlay of the input event layer onto the target LRS Network to generate features for the input event along the target network. These features will contain the Route ID and measure information of that location on the route.
The input event layer and the target network should only represent a single point in time to obtain an accurate output. If the input event layer represents multiple points in time, set a filter using the time slider or use a definition query on the date columns.

topic: 翻譯事件措施(遠程參考工具)
text: 輸出資料可以使用“附加事件”工具添加到新的或現有的 LRS 事件中。如果輸入事件層包含多個時間表達方式,并導致該工具與不同日期過濾器多次運行,則每個產出都可以使用“追加事件”添加到單一的LRS 事件特征類中。

z 因子是一個轉換因子，當輸入表面的垂直座標（或高程）單位與水平座標 (x,y) 單位不同時，可使用 z 因子調整垂直座標（或高程）單位的測量單位。 它表示一個表面 z 單位所對應的地面 x,y 單位的數量。 如果垂直單位沒有相對于水平單位進行校正，則表面工具的結果將不會正確。
當計算輸出表面時，將用 z 因子乘以輸入表面的 z 值。 如果 x,y 單位與 z 單位完全相同（例如都是以英尺為單位），則 z 因子為 1。 這是 z 因子的默認值。 再例如，如果垂直的 z 單位是英尺而水平的 x,y 單位是米，則應使用 z 因子 0.3048 將 z 單位從英尺轉換為米（1 英尺 = 0.3048 米）。
當輸入網格位于球面座標系（例如十進制度球面座標系）中時，正確使用 z 因子尤為重要。 如果輸入表面網格不在投影座標系統中，則從山體陰影中得到的輸出通常看起來會很奇怪。 這是因為水平地面單位與高程 z 單位之間的測量值存在差異。 由于經度的長度隨著緯度而變化，因此需要為該緯度指定一個適當的 z 因子。

Only variables that have been added to the level will be available.
Territories are constrained by the Minimum, Maximum, and Ideal Value values.
Set the Constraints parameter's Weight option to 100 if there is only one variable that will be used for constraints.
The Constraints parameter's Weight option will be set automatically if there are multiple variables.
The Constraints parameter's Maximum and Minimum options are hard constraints. Territories will not exceed or be below the specified values.
The Constraints parameter's Ideal Value option is a soft constraint. Territories can exceed or be below the specified value.

topic: 從文檔中提取位置 (轉換工具)
chapter: 轉出至地理資料庫工具集
text:
分析包含非結構化或半結構化文本（例如電子郵件消息、行程表單等）的文檔，并將位置提取到點圖徵類。
該工具可分析和處理輸入文檔，如下所示：
識別在文檔內容中指定的空間座標，并創建表示這些位置的點。 可識別以下座標格式：十進制度、度十進制分、度分秒、通用橫軸墨卡托和軍事格網參考系統。
識別文檔內容中指定的且在自定義位置文件中定義的地名，并創建表示這些位置的點。 自定義位置文件會將地名與表示該位置的空間座標相關聯。
識別感興趣文本，從文檔中提取此信息，并將其記錄在輸出圖徵類屬性表的欄位中。
此工具支持所有 Microsoft Office 文檔（Word、PowerPoint 和 Excel）；Adobe PDF 文檔；標記文本，例如 XML 和 HTML 文檔；以及包含純文本的任何文件，例如文本文件 (.txt)。

topic: 從文檔中提取位置 (轉換工具)
chapter: 轉出至地理資料庫工具集
text:
參數默認值旨在優化座標和日期的標識。 每個參數的默認值都可以修改。 修改的參數越少，工具的運行速度就越快。
所有座標格式默認為打開。 如果只想提取自定義位置而不想提取空間座標，請關閉座標格式參數。
如果提供的輸入是 Adobe PDF 文檔，其內容包括空間座標，且格式已打開，而輸出圖徵類不包含表示空間座標的圖徵，則您的計算機可能沒有處理 PDF 文檔所需的組件。 了解有關掃描文件的詳細信息
使用自定義位置文件提取地名時，最好在文件中指定較少的地名。 例如，如果您將一個代表世界上所有地方的圖徵類轉換為自定義位置文件，那么在這個過程中，您可能需要花費大量時間來查找不可能存在的地方，或者在您不感興趣的領域進行分析。 了解自定義位置文件的詳細信息
如果您感興趣的地名拼寫錯誤或有已知的變體，那么在自定義位置文件中指定常見的拼寫錯誤和替代地名，而不是使用模糊匹配，通常會得到更好的結果。 開啟模糊匹配后，如果地名中 70% 的字符與輸入內容匹配，就會得到一個輸出位置。 與提供已知的替代地名和拼寫錯誤相比，這可能會產生更多的誤報。 模糊匹配的一個有用工作流程是，首先在關閉模糊匹配的情況下運行工具。 然后，再次在打開模糊匹配的情況下運行工具并檢查結果。 這有助于識別可添加到自定義位置文件的拼寫差異。 了解模糊匹配的詳細信息

values: 模板文件 (*.lxttmpl) 用于確定每個工具參數的設置。 如果提供了模板文件，除了決定要處理的輸入內容和輸出圖徵類的參數值外，其他參數的所有指定值都將被忽略。 提取位置窗格中的某些設置，只有在這些設置被保存到模板文件且在此參數中引用了該模板文件時，才可供此工具使用。 按如下所示設置： Spatial coordinates in x,y format—允許將兩個連續的數字（如 630084 4833438 或 981075.652ftUS 607151.272ftUS）識別為座標，前提是它們對與輸入文檔相關的平面座標系有效。 您可以指定識別帶單位和不帶單位的數字，還是只識別帶度量單位的數字作為座標。 Custom coordinate and date formats—允許您自定義將文本識別為空間座標或日期的方式，尤其是用英語以外的語言書寫或使用在美國不常用的格式時。 例如，在識別寫為 30 20 10 N x 060 50 40 W 的空間座標時，可以進行自定義，將經緯度之間的字符 x 識別為有效文本。 為適應文檔的語言（本例中為法語）而進行自定義時，可以識別 60.91°N, 147.34°O 和 17 juillet, 2018 等座標和日期。 此外，當使用兩位數年份時，您可以控制與之匹配的年份范圍。 Preferences for some ambiguous dates—諸如 10/12/2019 這樣的日期是模糊的，因為它們既可以被解釋為 2019 年 10 月 12 日，也可以被解釋為 2019 年 12 月 10 日。 一些國家使用 m/d/yy 日期格式作為標準，其他國家則使用 d/m/yy 格式。 可以設置如何解釋這些模糊日期的偏好，可以是 m/d/yy 或 d/m/yy，以適應文檔的原產國。 Length of fields in the output feature class—您可以使用前文本欄位長度（Python 中的 pre_text_length）和后文本欄位長度（Python 中的 post_text_length）參數，指定從文檔中提取的空間座標周圍包含文本的欄位長度。 通過提取位置窗格，您可以控制屬性表中幾個其他欄位的長度，包括包含從文檔中提取的日期、轉換為日期的原始文本、提取信息的文件名等欄位。

指定是否將逗號 (,) 識別為小數分隔符。 默認情況下，掃描內容中由使用句號 (.) 或中間點 (·) 作為小數分隔符的數字定義的空間座標，例如：Lat 01° 10·80' N Long 103° 28·60' E。 如果要處理的內容中，空間座標由使用逗號 (,) 作為小數分隔符的數字定義，例如：52° 8′ 32,14″ N; 5° 24′ 56,09″ E，則將此參數設置為識別逗號作為小數分隔符。 該參數不會根據計算機操作系統的區域設置自動設置。 選中—逗號將被識別為小數分隔符。 未選中—句號或中間點將被識別為小數分隔符。 這是默認設置。

values: 指定是否使用詞內換行搜索文本。 當單詞（文本）由空格或標點符號（如歐洲語言）界定時，就會出現詞內換行。 根據文本語言的不同，此設置可以生成頻繁的誤報或不頻繁的誤報。 例如，在不要求單詞邊界的情況下，英文文本 Bernard 將產生與文本 San Bernardino 匹配的結果，而這很可能被視為誤報。 但是，當使用不使用詞內換行的語言編寫文本時，如果需要詞內換行，則無法找到單詞。 例如，對于 I flew to Tokyo（我飛往東京）這一日語文本，私は東京に飛んで，在不要求單詞邊界的情況下，您只能找到 Tokyo一詞，東京。 選中—該工具將搜索由空格或標點符號界定的單詞。 這是默認設置。 未選中—該工具將不會搜索由空格或標點符號界定的單詞。

values: 模板文件 (*.lxttmpl) 用于確定每個工具參數的設置。 如果提供了模板文件，除了決定要處理的輸入內容和輸出圖徵類的參數值外，其他參數的所有指定值都將被忽略。 提取位置窗格中的某些設置，只有在這些設置被保存到模板文件且在此參數中引用了該模板文件時，才可供此工具使用。 按如下所示設置： Spatial coordinates in x,y format—允許將兩個連續的數字（如 630084 4833438 或 981075.652ftUS 607151.272ftUS）識別為座標，前提是它們對與輸入文檔相關的平面座標系有效。 您可以指定識別帶單位和不帶單位的數字，還是只識別帶度量單位的數字作為座標。 Custom coordinate and date formats—允許您自定義將文本識別為空間座標或日期的方式，尤其是用英語以外的語言書寫或使用在美國不常用的格式時。 例如，在識別寫為 30 20 10 N x 060 50 40 W 的空間座標時，可以進行自定義，將經緯度之間的字符 x 識別為有效文本。 為適應文檔的語言（本例中為法語）而進行自定義時，可以識別 60.91°N, 147.34°O 和 17 juillet, 2018 等座標和日期。 此外，當使用兩位數年份時，您可以控制與之匹配的年份范圍。 Preferences for some ambiguous dates—諸如 10/12/2019 這樣的日期是模糊的，因為它們既可以被解釋為 2019 年 10 月 12 日，也可以被解釋為 2019 年 12 月 10 日。 一些國家使用 m/d/yy 日期格式作為標準，其他國家則使用 d/m/yy 格式。 可以設置如何解釋這些模糊日期的偏好，可以是 m/d/yy 或 d/m/yy，以適應文檔的原產國。 Length of fields in the output feature class—您可以使用前文本欄位長度（Python 中的 pre_text_length）和后文本欄位長度（Python 中的 post_text_length）參數，指定從文檔中提取的空間座標周圍包含文本的欄位長度。 通過提取位置窗格，您可以控制屬性表中幾個其他欄位的長度，包括包含從文檔中提取的日期、轉換為日期的原始文本、提取信息的文件名等欄位。

values: 指定是否將逗號 (,) 識別為小數分隔符。 默認情況下，掃描內容中由使用句號 (.) 或中間點 (·) 作為小數分隔符的數字定義的空間座標，例如：Lat 01° 10·80' N Long 103° 28·60' E。 如果要處理的內容中，空間座標由使用逗號 (,) 作為小數分隔符的數字定義，例如：52° 8′ 32,14″ N; 5° 24′ 56,09″ E，則將此參數設置為識別逗號作為小數分隔符。 該參數不會根據計算機操作系統的區域設置自動設置。 USE_COMMA_DECIMAL_MARK—逗號將被識別為小數分隔符。 USE_DOT_DECIMAL_MARK—句號或中間點將被識別為小數分隔符。 這是默認設置。

values: 指定是否使用詞內換行搜索文本。 當單詞（文本）由空格或標點符號（如歐洲語言）界定時，就會出現詞內換行。 根據文本語言的不同，此設置可以生成頻繁的誤報或不頻繁的誤報。 例如，在不要求單詞邊界的情況下，英文文本 Bernard 將產生與文本 San Bernardino 匹配的結果，而這很可能被視為誤報。 但是，當使用不使用詞內換行的語言編寫文本時，如果需要詞內換行，則無法找到單詞。 例如，對于 I flew to Tokyo（我飛往東京）這一日語文本，私は東京に飛んで，在不要求單詞邊界的情況下，您只能找到 Tokyo一詞，東京。 REQ_WORD_BREAKS—該工具將搜索由空格或標點符號界定的單詞。 這是默認設置。 DONT_REQ_WORD_BREAKS—該工具將不會搜索由空格或標點符號界定的單詞。

steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Extract Locations From Document，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸入文件 [in_file]、輸出圖徵類 [out_feature_class]、輸入模板 （可選） [in_template]、經度和緯度 （可選） [coord_dd_latlon]、帶度數符號的 X Y （可選） [coord_dd_xydeg]、無符號的 X Y （可選） [coord_dd_xyplain]、經度和緯度 （可選） [coord_dm_latlon]、帶分符號的 X Y （可選） [coord_dm_xymin]、經度和緯度 （可選） [coord_dms_latlon]、帶秒符號的 X Y （可選） [coord_dms_xysec]、帶分隔符的 X Y （可選） [coord_dms_xysep]、通用橫軸墨卡托投影 （可選） [coord_utm]、UPS 北極 （可選） [coord_ups_north]、UPS 南極 （可選） [coord_ups_south]、軍事格網參考系 （可選） [coord_mgrs]、北極 （可選） [coord_mgrs_northpolar]、南極 （可選） [coord_mgrs_southpolar]、使用逗號作為小數分隔符 （可選） [comma_decimal]、解釋為經度、緯度 （可選） [coord_use_lonlat]、輸入座標系 （可選） [in_coor_system]、輸入自定義位置 （可選） [in_custom_locations]、使用模糊匹配 （可選） [fuzzy_match]、所提取的最大圖徵數 （可選） [max_features_extracted]、忽略此第一個圖徵數 （可選） [ignore_first_features]、所用月份名稱 （可選） [date_monthname]、M/D/Y 和 D/M/Y （可選） [date_m_d_y]、YYYYMMDD （可選） [date_yyyymmdd]、YYMMDD （可選） [date_yymmdd]、YYJJJ （可選） [date_yyjjj]、所提取的最大日期數 （可選） [max_dates_extracted]、忽略此第一個日期數 （可選） [ignore_first_dates]、可接受日期范圍的最早日期 （可選） [date_range_begin]、可接受日期范圍的最近日期 （可選） [date_range_end]、輸入自定義屬性 （可選） [in_custom_attributes]、輸入文件鏈接文本 （可選） [file_link]、輸入文件日期和時間 （可選） [file_mod_datetime]、前文本欄位長度 （可選） [pre_text_length]、后文本欄位長度 （可選） [post_text_length]、座標格式 （可選） [std_coord_fmt]、需要詞內換行 （可選） [req_word_breaks]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The input file that will be scanned for locations (coordinates or custom locations), dates, and custom attributes; or a folder in which all files in the folder will be scanned for locations.
The feature class containing point features that represent the locations that were found.

The template file (*.lxttmpl) that determines the setting to use for each tool parameter. When a template file is provided, all values specified for other parameters will be ignored except those that determine the input content that will be processed and the output feature class. Some settings that are available in the Extract Locations pane are only available to this tool when the settings are saved to a template file, and the template file is referenced in this parameter. These settings are as follows: Spatial coordinates in x,y format—Allows two sequential numbers such as 630084 4833438 or 981075.652ftUS 607151.272ftUS to be recognized as coordinates when they are valid for a planar coordinate system associated with the input documents. You can specify whether numbers with and without units are recognized or only numbers with units of measure are recognized as coordinates. Custom coordinate and date formats—Allows you to customize how text is recognized as a spatial coordinate or a date, particularly when written in a language other than English or using a format that is not common in the United States. For example, a spatial coordinate written as 30 20 10 N x 060 50 40 W can be recognized with a customization to recognize the character x as valid text between the latitude and longitude. Coordinates and dates such as 60.91°N, 147.34°O and 17 juillet, 2018 can be recognized when customizations are specified to accommodate the language of the documents, in this case French. Also, when two-digit years are used, you can control the range of years to which they are matched. Preferences for some ambiguous dates—Dates such as 10/12/2019 are ambiguous because they can be interpreted as either October 12, 2019, or December 10, 2019. Some countries use the m/d/yy date format as a standard, and other countries use the d/m/yy format. A preference can be set for how these ambiguous dates are interpreted, either as m/d/yy or d/m/yy, to suit the country of origin of the documents. Length of fields in the output feature class—You can specify the length of the fields containing text surrounding spatial coordinates that are extracted from a document using the Pre-Text Field Length (pre_text_length in Python) and Post-Text Field Length (post_text_length in Python) parameters. The Extract Locations pane allows you to control the length of several additional fields in the attribute table, including fields containing dates extracted from the document, the original text that was converted to dates, the file name from which the information was extracted, and so on.

Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as decimal degrees formatted as latitude and longitude (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 33.8N 77.035W and W77N38.88909. Checked—The tool will search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude.

parameters.label_zh: 帶度數符號的 X Y （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as decimal degrees formatted as X Y with degree symbols (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 38.8° -77.035° and -077d+38.88909d. Checked—The tool will search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as X Y with degree symbols. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as X Y with degree symbols.

parameters.label_zh: 無符號的 X Y （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as decimal degrees formatted as X Y with no symbols (frequent false positives). Examples are: 38.8 -77.035 and -077.0, +38.88909. Checked—The tool will search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as X Y with no symbols (frequent false positives). This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for decimal degrees coordinates formatted as X Y with no symbols.

Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as degrees decimal minutes formatted as latitude and longitude (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 3853.3N 7702.100W and W7702N3853.3458. Checked—The tool will search for degrees decimal minutes coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for degrees decimal minutes coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude.

parameters.label_zh: 帶分符號的 X Y （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as degrees decimal minutes formatted as X Y with minutes symbols (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 3853' -7702.1' and -07702m+3853.3458m. Checked—The tool will search for degrees decimal minutes coordinates formatted as X Y with minutes symbols. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for degrees decimal minutes coordinates formatted as X Y with minutes symbols.

Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as degrees minutes seconds formatted as latitude and longitude (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 385320.7N 770206.000W and W770206N385320.76. Checked—The tool will search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as latitude and longitude.

parameters.label_zh: 帶秒符號的 X Y （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as degrees minutes seconds formatted as X Y with seconds symbols (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 385320" -770206.0" and -0770206.0s+385320.76s. Checked—The tool will search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as X Y with seconds symbols. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as X Y with seconds symbols.

parameters.label_zh: 帶分隔符的 X Y （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for coordinates stored as degrees minutes seconds formatted as X Y with separators (moderate false positives). Examples are: 8:53:20 -77:2:6.0 and -077/02/06/+38/53/20.76. Checked—The tool will search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as X Y with separators. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for degrees minutes seconds coordinates formatted as X Y with separators.

parameters.label_zh: 通用橫軸墨卡托投影 （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to search for Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) coordinates (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 18S 323503 4306438 and 18 north 323503.25 4306438.39. Checked—The tool will search for UTM coordinates. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for UTM coordinates.

Specifies whether to search for Universal Polar Stereographic (UPS) coordinates in the north polar area (infrequent false positives). Examples are: Y 2722399 2000000 and north 2722399 2000000. Checked—The tool will search for UPS coordinates in the north polar area. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for UPS coordinates in the north polar area.

Specifies whether to search for Universal Polar Stereographic (UPS) coordinates in the south polar area (infrequent false positives). Examples are: A 2000000 3168892 and south 2000000 3168892. Checked—The tool will search for UPS coordinates in the south polar area. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for UPS coordinates in the south polar area.

Specifies whether to search for Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinates (infrequent false positives). Examples are: 18S UJ 13503 06438 and 18SUJ0306. Checked—The tool will search for MGRS coordinates. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for MGRS coordinates.

Specifies whether to search for Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinates in the north polar area (infrequent false positives). Examples are: Y TG 56814 69009 and YTG5669. Checked—The tool will search for MGRS coordinates in the north polar area. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for MGRS coordinates in the north polar area.

Specifies whether to search for Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinates in the south polar area (moderate false positives). Examples are: A TN 56814 30991 and ATN5630. Checked—The tool will search for MGRS coordinates in the south polar area. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for MGRS coordinates in the south polar area.

parameters.label_zh: 使用逗號作為小數分隔符 （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether a comma (,) will be recognized as a decimal separator. By default, content is scanned for spatial coordinates defined by numbers that use a period (.) or a middle dot (·) as the decimal separator, for example: Lat 01° 10·80' N Long 103° 28·60' E. If you are working with content in which spatial coordinates are defined by numbers that use a comma (,) as the decimal separator, for example: 52° 8′ 32,14″ N; 5° 24′ 56,09″ E, set this parameter to recognize a comma as the decimal separator instead. This parameter is not set automatically based on the regional setting for your computer's operating system. Checked—A comma will be recognized as the decimal separator. Unchecked—A period or a middle dot will be recognized as the decimal separator. This is the default.

When numbers resemble x,y coordinates, both numbers are less than 90, and there are no symbols or notations to indicate which number represents the latitude or longitude, results can be ambiguous. Interpret the numbers as a longitude-latitude coordinate (x,y) instead of a latitude-longitude coordinate (y,x). Checked—x,y coordinates will be interpreted as longitude-latitude. Unchecked—x,y coordinates will be interpreted as latitude-longitude. This is the default.
The coordinate system that will be used to interpret the spatial coordinates defined in the input. GCS-WGS-84 is the default.

The custom location file (.lxtgaz) that will be used when scanning the input content. A point is created to represent each occurrence of each place name in the custom location file up to the limits established by other tool parameters.

Specifies whether fuzzy matching will be used for searching the custom location file. Checked—Fuzzy matching will be used when searching the custom location file. Unchecked—Exact matching will be used when searching the custom location file. This is the default.

parameters.label_zh: 所提取的最大圖徵數 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The maximum number of features that can be extracted. The tool will stop scanning the input content for locations when the maximum number is reached. When running as a geoprocessing service, the service and the server may have separate limits on the number of features allowed.

parameters.label_zh: 忽略此第一個圖徵數 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Ignore This First Number of Features (Optional)
parameters.description_en: The number of features detected and ignored before extracting all other features. This parameter can be used to focus the search on a specific portion of the data.

Specifies whether to search for dates in which the month name appears (infrequent false positives). 12 May 2003 and January 15, 1997 are examples. Checked—The tool will search for dates in which the month name appears. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for dates in which the month name appears.

Specifies whether to search for dates in which numbers are in the M/D/Y or D/M/Y format (moderate false positives). 5/12/03 and 1-15-1997 are examples. Checked—The tool will search for dates in which numbers are in the M/D/Y or D/M/Y format (moderate false positives). This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for dates in which numbers are in the M/D/Y or D/M/Y format.

Specifies whether to search for dates in which numbers are in the YYYYMMDD format (moderate false positives). 20030512 and 19970115 are examples. Checked—The tool will search for dates in which numbers are in the YYYYMMDD format (moderate false positives). This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for dates in which numbers are in the YYYYMMDD format.

Specifies whether to search for dates in which numbers are in the YYMMDD format (frequent false positives). 030512 and 970115 are examples. Checked—The tool will search for dates in which numbers are in the YYMMDD format (frequent false positives). This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for dates in which numbers are in the YYMMDD format.

Specifies whether to search for dates in which numbers are in the YYJJJ or YYYYJJJ format (frequent false positives). 03132 and 97015 are examples. Checked—The tool will search for dates in which numbers are in the YYJJJ or YYYYJJJ format (frequent false positives). This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for dates in which numbers are in the YYJJJ or YYYYJJJ format.

parameters.label_zh: 所提取的最大日期數 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The maximum number of dates that will be extracted.

parameters.label_zh: 忽略此第一個日期數 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Ignore This First Number Of Dates (Optional)
parameters.description_en: The number of dates that will be detected and ignored before extracting all other dates.

parameters.label_zh: 可接受日期范圍的最早日期 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Earliest Date Of Acceptable Date Range (Optional)
parameters.description_en: The earliest acceptable date to extract. Detected dates matching this value or later will be extracted.

parameters.label_zh: 可接受日期范圍的最近日期 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Latest Date Of Acceptable Date Range (Optional)
parameters.description_en: The latest acceptable date to extract. Detected dates matching this value or earlier will be extracted.

The custom attribute file (.lxtca) that will be used to scan the input content. Fields will be created in the output feature class's attribute table for all custom attributes defined in the file. When the input content is scanned, it will be examined to see if it contains text associated with all custom attributes specified in the file. When a match is found, the appropriate text is extracted from the input content and stored in the appropriate field.

parameters.label_zh: 輸入文件鏈接文本 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The file path that will be used as the file name in the output data when the Input File parameter (in_file in Python) is transferred to the server. If this parameter is not specified, the path of the Input File will be used, which may be an unreachable folder on a server. This parameter has no effect when the Input File is not specified.

parameters.label_zh: 輸入文件日期和時間 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The UTC date and time that the file was modified will be used as the modified attribute in the output data when the Input File parameter (in_file in Python) is transferred to the server. If this parameter is not specified, the current modified time of the input file will be used. This parameter has no effect when the Input File is not specified.

Content is extracted from the input document to provide context for the location that was found. This parameter defines the maximum number of characters that will be extracted preceding the text that defines the location. The extracted text is stored in the Pre-Text field in the output feature class's attribute table. The default is 254. The Pre-Text field's data type will also have this length. The length of a text field in a shapefile is limited to 254 characters; when the output is a shapefile, a larger number of characters will be truncated to 254.

Content is extracted from the input document to provide context for the location that was found. This parameter defines the maximum number of characters that will be extracted following the text that defines the location. The extracted text is stored in the Post-Text field in the output feature class's attribute table. The default is 254. The Post-Text field's data type will also have this length. The length of a text field in a shapefile is limited to 254 characters; when the output is a shapefile, a larger number of characters will be truncated to 254.

Specifies the coordinate format that will be used to store the coordinate location. A standard representation of the spatial coordinate that defines the point feature is recorded in a field in the attribute table. DD - Decimal Degrees—The coordinate location is recorded in decimal degrees format. This is the default. DM - Degrees Decimal Minutes—The coordinate location is recorded in degrees decimal minutes format. DMS - Degrees Minutes Seconds—The coordinate location is recorded in degrees minutes seconds format. UTM - Universal Transverse Mercator—The coordinate location is recorded in Universal Transverse Mercator format. MGRS - Military Grid Reference System—The coordinate location is recorded in Military Grid Reference System format.

Specifies whether to search for text using word breaks. A word break occurs when words (text) are bounded by whitespace or punctuation characters as in European languages. This setting can produce frequent false positives or infrequent false positives depending on the language of the text. For example, when word breaks are not required, the English text Bernard will produce a match against the text San Bernardino, which would likely be considered a false positive. However, when text is written using a language that does not use word breaks, you cannot find words if word breaks are required. For example, with the text I flew to Tokyo in Japanese, 私は東京に飛んで, you would only be able to find the word Tokyo, 東京, when word breaks are not required. Checked—The tool will search for words that are bounded by whitespace or punctuation characters. This is the default. Unchecked—The tool will not search for words that are bounded by whitespace or punctuation characters.

topic: GeoAnalytics Desktop 工具箱中的空間關系
english: Spatial relationships in the GeoAnalytics Desktop toolbox
section: GeoAnalytics Desktop 工具箱中的空間關系
text:
連接圖徵工具允許您根據相對位置將一個圖層中的圖徵連接到另一個圖層中的圖徵。 這稱為空間連接。 與空間連接一起，連接圖徵也可用于應用時態連接和屬性連接。 在定義空間連接時，有多個空間關系可用于選擇一個圖層中的點、線或面圖徵，它們可顯示與另一個圖層中的圖徵的感興趣關系。
例如，要了解受近期洪水影響的房屋數量，您可以使用 Within 空間關系運算符將 Homes 圖層與洪水邊界連接。

GeoAnalytics Desktop 工具中支持的關系為 Clementini，表示面邊界獨立于其內部和外部。

topic: 在 ModelBuilder 中使用迭代器的示例
english: Examples of using iterators in ModelBuilder
text:
迭代圖徵選擇工具迭代圖徵類中的圖徵。
在下圖中，模型用于計算在五類一級颶風以 100 米寬席卷的行進路徑上，“東海岸”有多少土地覆被圖區域遭到破壞。 輸入圖徵變量是一個包括周圍 100 米寬的緩衝區在內的五類大西洋颶風行進路徑的圖徵類。 輸入網格變量是土地覆被網格。
在本例中，颶風的名稱被作為執行選擇的分組欄位，所選圖徵被作為以表格顯示分區統計工具的輸入，以便最終生成颶風登陸期間遭受破壞的土地覆被上相關統計資料的輸出表。
迭代圖徵選擇工具有兩個輸出：
所選圖徵（作為輸入與以表格顯示分區統計工具連接）。
值變量，包含用作輸出表變量輸出名稱中行內變量的圖徵（基于分組欄位）名稱。

topic: 在 ModelBuilder 中使用迭代器的示例
english: Examples of using iterators in ModelBuilder
text:
迭代行選擇工具迭代表中的行。
在下圖中，模型可為一天中不同時段（上午、下午、傍晚和夜間）發生的盜竊案件創建標準差橢圓，用以偵查犯罪的基本模式。
輸入圖徵類變量是一個包含犯罪案件點的圖徵類。 其中包含欄位 Crime_Peri（犯罪時段），該欄位是指案件發生的時段（字符串 Morning、Afternoon、Evening 和 Night）。 此欄位用作進行選擇的分組欄位，所選行用于創建輸出標準差橢圓。
該工具有兩個輸出：
包含唯一犯罪時段的所選行的行選擇變量。 這些行是方向分布（標準差橢圓）工具的輸入。
值變量，包含分組欄位（Morning、Afternoon、Evening 或 Night）的值。 此值被用作輸出標準差橢圓變量的輸出名稱中的行內變量。

topic: 在 ModelBuilder 中使用迭代器的示例
english: Examples of using iterators in ModelBuilder
text:
迭代欄位工具迭代表中的欄位。
在下圖中，模型使用計算欄位工具將多個欄位中的空值轉換為零。
事件圖徵圖層變量具有唯一的欄位，該欄位按日期統計事件的數量。 一些具有缺失值的欄位存儲為空值。 在這種情況下，迭代欄位工具用于基于通配符和已過濾欄位列表的子集過濾日期。 然后每個欄位將傳遞至按屬性選擇圖層工具，然后所選記錄將傳遞到計算欄位工具。
該工具有兩個輸出：
值變量作為輸入欄位名稱連接到按屬性選擇圖層工具。
計數變量保留要迭代的欄位總數。

topic: 在 ModelBuilder 中使用迭代器的示例
english: Examples of using iterators in ModelBuilder
text:
迭代欄位值工具迭代欄位中的所有值。

迭代欄位值有一個輸出：包含欄位的值的值變量，被用作聚類和異常值分析工具的距離范圍或距離閾值參數。 值變量也可使用行內變量替換來構造輸出聚類圖徵類變量的輸出文件名。

text:
迭代時間工具在日期欄位中隨時間迭代。
在以下示例中，輸入表包含 1981 年至 2020 年的降水資料，不包括干旱天數。 迭代時間工具使用 Date 欄位將輸入資料分成一個月的時間片。 從每個月的選定行中，使用匯總統計資料工具計算平均降水量和下雨天數。 計算欄位工具用于使用行內變量替換將每次迭代的格式化開始時間值添加到匯總表中。 可以使用追加工具追加每個月的匯總表以生成一個表。
在以下示例中，輸入表包含 2000 年至 2018 年的龍卷風資料及其量級。 該模型針對 2008 年至 2018 年期間的資料子集，匯總了 5 月和 6 月按量級劃分的龍卷風頻率。 迭代時間工具使用 Date 欄位將輸入資料劃分為每年的時間片。 該工具根據迭代開始時間、迭代結束時間和時間定義參數中定義的值來限制資料范圍。 可以使用匯總統計資料工具對龍卷風進行匯總，并且計算欄位工具將向輸出中添加年份。 最后，將每年的輸出追加到一個表中。

topic: 遷移至公共設施網絡 (公共設施網絡工具)
text:
基于您提供的資料、結構和映射參數，在移動地理資料庫中創建公共設施網絡，從而支持基本的編輯和追蹤工作流。
此工具能夠利用您現有的資料，自動創建公共設施網絡。 它可以將幾何網絡資料或非網絡資料轉換為移動地理資料庫中的公共設施網絡，同時保留現有圖徵類的結構。

topic: 遷移至公共設施網絡 (公共設施網絡工具)
text:
對于源類和獨立類參數，所有資料必須來自地理資料庫。
對于包含相關類和包括附件參數，所有關系和附件都必須使用全局 ID 主鍵。不支持多對多關系和屬性關系。
對于域網絡參數值，為了正確設置子網控制器類型和層定義參數值，請務必理解公共設施網絡對傳統域網絡 的管理方式。 要了解詳細信息，請參閱子網控制器類型 和層定義。
對于公共設施網絡映射參數，所有編輯者追蹤欄位 都將映射到默認欄位：created_user、created_date、last_edited_user 和 last_edited_date。
了解公共設施網絡圖徵的分類，有助于更好地設置多個公共設施網絡映射參數值。

values: 公共設施網絡映射 （可選）

用于生成和映射輸出地理資料庫中公共設施網絡的資產組和資產類型的圖徵類列表，及其詳細信息。 值表列： Source Class—The source feature class that will be migrated to a utility network. Target Class—The target domain network class for each Source Class value. Asset Group—The name of the asset group created in the target domain network class. By default, this is assigned the name from Source Class. Asset Type—The subtype or field with a coded value domain that will be used to define the asset types for the asset group created in Target Class. If the data contains subtypes, or another field containing a coded value domain that can be used to meaningfully identify different types of equipment in the class, this can be specified as the field to be used for the asset type in Target Class. When a subtype field is specified for Asset Type, existing codes are maintained if all codes are between 1 and 1023. If a code falls outside this range, all asset types will be created using the subtype descriptions and an automatically incrementing number starting at 1. Is Controller—Specify whether the feature classes can act as sources or sinks in the domain network. This enables features belonging to this asset group to act as subnetwork controllers in the output domain network. Controller—The specified asset group and asset types are assigned the subnetwork controller network category and are eligible to define the origin of a subnetwork. If the source feature class participates in a geometric network, the values from the Ancillary Role field are used to determine which features for the asset group and asset type can serve as subnetwork controllers in the utility network. These features are output to the folder specified for the Output Location parameter in a controllers.csv file for later import into the output utility network. When no Ancillary Role field is present, subnetwork controllers can be set manually for the specified asset types in the output utility network. No Controller—The specified asset group and asset types are not assigned the subnetwork controller network category and are not eligible to participate as subnetwork controllers in the domain network.

topic: 遷移至公共設施網絡 (公共設施網絡工具)
values: 定義將在輸出公共設施網絡中創建的域網絡 或網絡的名稱和屬性。 值表列： Name—The name of the domain network. This describes the resource that the domain network manages and will prefix all network classes added to the domain network. Subnetwork Controller Type—The subnetwork controller type determines how the network resource flows through all subnetworks of a domain network. Specify whether resources originate from a point in the network (source) or flow toward a point in the network (sink). Source—If the domain network is defined with the source subnetwork controller type, a resource can only flow away from or exit subnetwork controllers, not toward or into them. Sink—If the domain network is defined with a sink subnetwork controller type, a resource can only flow toward and enter subnetwork controllers, not away from or exit them. Tier Definition—Specify the tier definition type for the domain network, either partitioned or hierarchical. A tier definition denotes the organization of the tiers relative to the rest of the network. Partitioned—Features in a domain network with a partitioned tier definition are independent and can only exist in one tier. Features can exist in one or multiple subnetworks. The relationship between tiers in partitioned domain networks is ordered and linear. For example, a transmission tier delivers the resource over a long distance, and a distribution tier serves the resource to the customer. Hierarchical—Features in a domain network with a hierarchical tier definition can be modeled in multiple types of subnetworks. For example, pressure zones and isolation zones can be defined in two tiers within a tier group. A gas or water feature can be part of both the pressure and isolation tiers.

This describes the resource that the domain network manages and will prefix all network classes added to the domain network. Subnetwork Controller Type—The subnetwork controller type determines how the network resource flows through all subnetworks of a domain network. Specify whether resources originate from a point in the network (source) or flow toward a point in the network (sink). SOURCE—If the domain network is defined with the source subnetwork controller type, a resource can only flow away from or exit subnetwork controllers, not toward or into them. SINK—If the domain network is defined with a sink subnetwork controller type, a resource can only flow toward and enter subnetwork controllers, not away from or exit them. Tier Definition—Specify the tier definition type for the domain network, either partitioned or hierarchical. A tier definition denotes the organization of the tiers relative to the rest of the network. PARTITIONED—Features in a domain network with a partitioned tier definition are independent and can only exist in one tier. Features can exist in one or multiple subnetworks. The relationship between tiers in partitioned domain networks is ordered and linear. For example, a transmission tier delivers the resource over a long distance, and a distribution tier serves the resource to the customer. HIERARCHICAL—Features in a domain network with a hierarchical tier definition can be modeled in multiple types of subnetworks. For example, pressure zones and isolation zones can be defined in two tiers within a tier group. A gas or water feature can be part of both the pressure and isolation tiers.

steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Migrate To Utility Network，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸出文件夾 [output_folder]、服務區圖徵類 [service_territory_feature_class]、公共設施網絡名稱 （可選） [utility_network_name]、圖徵資料集名稱 （可選） [dataset_name]、輸出名稱 （可選） [output_name]、公共設施網絡映射 （可選） [un_mapping]、域網絡 （可選） [domain_networks]、獨立類 （可選） [in_standalone_classes]、加載資料 （可選） [load_data]、合并欄位至公共設施網絡類 （可選） [merge_fields]、包含相關類 （可選） [include_related]、包括附件 （可選） [include_attachments]、公共設施網絡版本 [utility_network_version]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。
